description: This is a PHP source file defining the FreeCheckout class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. The class extends the core Controller and implements payment-related functionalities for the 'free checkout' payment method, including displaying a payment option and handling order confirmation logic.

classes.name: FreeCheckout
classes.description: A controller class managing the 'free checkout' payment method, extending the core OpenCart Controller class, providing methods for displaying the payment option and processing order confirmation.
